text:
Nora Patel: quick proposal  run a 2-week micro-playtest with 6 design partners to validate our short onboarding path + launch gates before broader beta. aim: surface top 3 friction points and measure early adoption signal.

Miles Hart: thumbs up. who do we pick?

Nora Patel: mix: 2 infra SDK integrators, 2 chat-heavy apps, 2 analytics teams. require a 15-min smoke test and a 3-question survey to qualify.

Iris Gomez: put telemetry opt-in on the invite. also include one workload sample (50 requests) so eng can pre-tune batching/quant.

Victor Chen: success gates suggestion: 1) avg onboarding time < 5 days, 2) <=1 critical support ping per partner, 3) adoption flag toggled on >= 2 routes.

Miles Hart: incentives: $2k credit + onboarding office hours (2 sessions).

all-hands-bot: Reminder scheduled: post invite draft to #product-drafts at 1600 today.

Nora Patel: action items: Nora write invite + survey, Iris build 50-request fingerprint, Victor draft success-gate doc, Miles craft incentive note. target kickoff in 10 days.

Iris Gomez: i'll mock the fingerprint script and share in #devex by EOD tomorrow.

Nora Patel: sweet. keep updates short in this thread. :rocket:
